# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric is a handsome and youthful boy who closely resembles his father, Stephen Stanhope. He dresses in an elegant fur cap and coat.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)_

## Personality

Cedric is a bright, imaginative, and manly child who feels completely comfortable speaking with adults. Possessing a poetic mind and a vivid imagination, he maintains imaginary rock people and dream companions. He is affectionate yet holds firm principles, promising his grandmother to avoid anyone who uses bad language.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028), [v2 c23 P34](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0034)_

## History

Cedric moved from Boston to live near the beach with his grandmother, Mrs. Stanhope, and father. He enrolled at Brierley School under the instruction of Nell Harcourt, becoming a well-liked pupil among both his teacher and fellow classmates. While attending school, he engaged in a notable physical fight with St. Clair Trask over a patriotic dispute regarding their national flags, ending in a mutual pact to respect each other's patriotism. Nell introduced him to Miss Rosalind Penrose at her stone house after learning of Rosalind's past relationship with his father; during the visit, Cedric charmed Miss Rosalind and agreed to become special friends with her. On various occasions, he also visited Grey Shutters for meals.
